title: Lakebase streaming sink is generally available
body: The Lakebase streaming sink is generally available. It now supports `Trigger.AvailableNow()` on serverless jobs and notebooks. In Databricks Runtime 19 and above, it also supports merge strategies and additive schema evolution (`mergeSchema`). Writing to an external PostgreSQL database through a Unity Catalog connection is in [Public Preview](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). See [Connect to Lakebase](/aws/en/structured-streaming/lakebase).
